economy.summary: Is the prime sponsor of House Bill 1150 (2025), which would amend the Minimum Wage Act to raise Pennsylvania's minimum wage to $15 per hour with annual cost-of-living increases and raise the tipped minimum wage.
economy.short: Prime-sponsored bill to raise minimum wage to $15.

abortion.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 26 (2025), the Reproductive Freedom Act, which would provide for reproductive rights and repeal or modify various existing provisions relating to abortion.
abortion.short: Co-sponsored Reproductive Freedom Act on abortion rights.

education.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 224 (2025), which would amend the Public School Code to provide for higher education accountability and transparency through a comparison tool.
education.short: Co-sponsored higher-education accountability and transparency bill.

energy.summary: Co-sponsored House Bill 501 (2025), which would amend the Alternative Energy Portfolio Standards Act, revising portfolio requirements and providing for zero emissions credits.
energy.short: Co-sponsored bill revising alternative energy portfolio standards.

guns.summary: Her official House biography lists sensible gun reform to combat the gun violence epidemic among her stated legislative priorities.
guns.short: Lists sensible gun reform among her legislative priorities.
